g.text: Time fraction per cluster during [10, 60) s
ARM 3005: CPU saturation duration across six clusters
Each dot is one cluster; annotated ranges are min–max across six clusters, not uncertainty or request-duration percentiles.
90% is a reporting threshold only. One workload run per policy; all 9,999 complete bins and 96 CPUs reported covered.
